---
name: Hardware compatibility
about: Report a tested CPU, host or firmware configuration
title: "[Hardware] "
---

A hardware model name is useful context, but actual test evidence is what establishes compatibility. Questions about untested configurations are welcome as questions, not as confirmed results.

## Hardware and software

CPU model/stepping, RAM, firmware, host OS/kernel, relevant GPU/device models. Do not include serial numbers.

## Project revision

Commit, source pin, module or image version.

## Execution environment

Physical hosted, standalone TCG/KVM or build-only. Specify whether the CPU is physical or emulated.

## Verified boundary

What actually ran? Include exact commands and sanitized result.

## Limitations

What was not tested? Did the host recover normally?
